message.content:
**Your 7‑Day Paris Adventure – “Paris in a Week”**

> *Assumptions:*  
> • You’ll arrive on **Monday** and depart on **Sunday**.  
> • You’re flying from a major U.S. hub (e.g., JFK, LAX, ORD).  
> • You prefer a mix of iconic sights, hidden gems, and culinary delights.  
> • Budget: mid‑range ($1,200–$1,800 per person, excluding airfare).

---

## Day 1 – Monday: Arrival & Settling In

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 12:00 PM | Arrive at Charles de Gaulle (CDG) | Take the RER B to Gare du Nord (≈35 min). |
| 1:30 PM | Check‑in at **Hotel Le Six** (Le Marais) | 4‑star boutique, 2‑star rating, 4‑star rating. |
| 3:00 PM | Walk to **Place des Vosges** | Relax, grab a coffee at Café Charlot. |
| 5:30 PM | Dinner at **L’As du Fallafel** | Famous falafel spot in Le Marais. |
| 8:00 PM | Evening stroll along the Seine | Snap sunset photos, enjoy street performers. |

**Why this works:**  
- Le Marais is centrally located, close to many attractions.  
- Early dinner lets you recover from jet lag without feeling rushed.

---

## Day 2 – Tuesday: Classic Landmarks

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 9:00 AM | Breakfast at **Café de Flore** | Iconic café, try croissants & café au lait. |
| 10:30 AM | Visit **Notre‑Dame** & **Sainte‑Chapelle** | Pre‑book tickets to skip lines. |
| 12:30 PM | Lunch at **Le Petit Cler** | Traditional French bistro near the market. |
| 2:00 PM | Explore **Île de la Cité** & **Île Saint‑Louis** | Walk across Pont Neuf, enjoy the river view. |
| 4:00 PM | Louvre Museum | 2‑hour guided tour (or audio guide). |
| 7:00 PM | Dinner at **Le Comptoir du Relais** | Classic French cuisine, reservations recommended. |
| 9:00 PM | Night cruise on the Seine | 1‑hour cruise, optional champagne. |

**Why this works:**  
- Combines must‑see landmarks with a relaxed pace.  
- Guided tours reduce time spent in queues.

---

## Day 3 – Wednesday: Art & Culture

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 9:00 AM | Breakfast at **Du Pain et des Idées** | Renowned for pain au chocolat. |
| 10:00 AM | Visit **Musée d’Orsay** | Impressionist masterpieces; pre‑book. |
| 12:30 PM | Lunch at **Café Campana** | Near Musée d’Orsay, great views of the Seine. |
| 2:00 PM | Explore **Montmartre** | Sacré‑Coeur, Place du Tertre, artists’ square. |
| 4:30 PM | Visit **Espace Dalí** | Surrealist art in Montmartre. |
| 7:00 PM | Dinner at **Le Coq Rico** | Roast poultry, excellent wine list. |
| 9:00 PM | Attend a show at **Moulin Rouge** | Book a dinner‑show package. |

**Why this works:**  
- Balances world‑class museums with the bohemian vibe of Montmartre.  
- Evening show adds a memorable cultural experience.

---

## Day 4 – Thursday: Gardens & Shopping

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 9:00 AM | Breakfast at **Boulangerie Poilâne** | Classic French bakery. |
| 10:00 AM | Stroll through **Jardin du Luxembourg** | Relax, maybe rent a bike. |
| 12:00 PM | Lunch at **L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon** | Michelin‑starred, but affordable lunch menu. |
| 2:00 PM | Shopping in **Galeries Lafayette** | Iconic department store, rooftop terrace. |
| 4:30 PM | Visit **Palais Garnier** | Opera house tour (pre‑book). |
| 7:00 PM | Dinner at **Septime** | Contemporary French, reservations essential. |
| 9:30 PM | Night walk along the **Pont Alexandre III** | Stunning illuminated bridge. |

**Why this works:**  
- Combines leisure (gardens) with luxury shopping.  
- Palais Garnier offers a glimpse into Parisian opulence.

---

## Day 5 – Friday: Day Trip to Versailles

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 8:00 AM | Breakfast at hotel | Quick bite before departure. |
| 9:00 AM | Take RER C to Versailles Château | 45 min ride. |
| 10:00 AM | Tour the **Palace of Versailles** | Guided tour, skip‑the‑line ticket. |
| 12:30 PM | Picnic in the **Gardens of Versailles** | Pick up baguettes, cheese, wine from a local shop. |
| 3:00 PM | Explore the **Grand Trianon** & **Queen’s Hamlet** | Smaller, intimate sites. |
| 5:30 PM | Return to Paris | RER C back to central station. |
| 7:00 PM | Dinner at **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** | Famous steak‑frites, no reservations needed. |
| 9:00 PM | Optional jazz club in **Le Marais** | Check out **Le Caveau de la Huchette**. |

**Why this works:**  
- Versailles is a must‑visit; a day trip keeps it manageable.  
- Picnic adds a relaxed, quintessentially French touch.

---

## Day 6 – Saturday: Modern Paris & Food Markets

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 9:00 AM | Breakfast at **Café Kitsuné** | Trendy café in Jardin du Palais‑Royal. |
| 10:00 AM | Visit **Centre Pompidou** | Modern art museum, rooftop view. |
| 12:00 PM | Lunch at **Marché des Enfants Rouges** | Oldest covered market, diverse stalls. |
| 2:00 PM | Explore **Le Marais** again | Boutique shops, vintage stores. |
| 4:00 PM | Coffee break at **Café Charlot** | Revisit for a different vibe. |
| 6:00 PM | Sunset at **Trocadéro Gardens** | Best view of Eiffel Tower. |
| 7:30 PM | Dinner at **Frenchie To Go** | Casual yet high‑quality. |
| 9:30 PM | Nightlife in **Pigalle** | Bars, clubs, or a relaxed cocktail lounge. |

**Why this works:**  
- Highlights modern culture and culinary diversity.  
- Sunset at Trocadéro is Instagram‑worthy.

---

## Day 7 – Sunday: Departure

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 8:00 AM | Breakfast at hotel | Pack and check‑out. |
| 9:00 AM | Last‑minute souvenir shopping | Grab a bottle of French wine or a macarons box. |
| 10:30 AM | Head to CDG via RER B | Aim to arrive 2 hrs before flight. |
| 1:00 PM | Depart Paris | Safe travels! |

---

## Transportation Tips

| Mode | How to Use | Cost (per person) |
|------|------------|-------------------|
| **RER B** | From CDG to city center | €10.30 single ticket |
| **RER C** | Versailles day trip | €7.50 single ticket |
| **Metro** | City exploration | €1.90 per ride (single) or €14.90 for a 72‑hr pass |
| **Bus** | Scenic routes | Same as metro |
| **Bike‑share (Vélib’)** | Short trips | €1.90 per 30 min, €7.50 per day |
| **Taxi/Uber** | Airport transfers | €50–€70 from CDG to city |

**Tip:** Buy a **Paris Visite** 72‑hr pass for unlimited metro/bus/RER within zones 1‑2 (≈€27.80). It covers most of your travel needs.

---

## Dining Highlights (per person)

| Meal | Restaurant | Approx. Cost |
|------|------------|--------------|
| Breakfast | Café de Flore | €10 |
| Lunch | L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon | €25 |
| Dinner | Septime | €70 |
| Snack | Marché des Enfants Rouges | €15 |
| Dessert | Ladurée (macarons) | €20 |

**Total for 7 days:** ~€200–€250

---

## Budget Summary (per person)

| Category | Cost |
|----------|------|
| Airfare | $600–$900 (depending on season) |
| Accommodation (Hotel Le Six) | $1,200–$1,500 |
| Food & Drink | $200–$250 |
| Attractions & Tours | $150–$200 |
| Transportation (within Paris) | $50–$70 |
| Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | $50–$100 |
| **Total** | **$2,250–$2,920** |

*(Adjust based on actual flight prices and personal spending habits.)*

---

## Packing Checklist

| Item | Why |
|------|-----|
| Comfortable walking shoes | Paris is best explored on foot. |
| Light jacket & umbrella | Weather can be unpredictable. |
| Power adapter (Type C/F) | For charging electronics. |
| Reusable water bottle | Stay hydrated. |
| Small daypack | Carry essentials during day trips. |
| Travel insurance | Peace of mind. |

---

## Final Tips

1. **Book tickets in advance** for Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, Palace of Versailles, and Moulin Rouge to avoid long queues.  
2. **Reserve restaurants** at least 48 hrs ahead, especially for Michelin‑starred places.  
3. **Use the Paris Pass** if you plan to visit many paid attractions; compare cost vs. individual tickets.  
4. **Learn basic French phrases** – locals appreciate the effort.  
5. **Stay flexible** – Paris is full of spontaneous events; keep a few free hours open each day.

Enjoy your Paris adventure! Bon voyage!
